RULED NOT BUILDABLE SAFELY and deliberately not built. Removing a slot does not merely lose information - the store then POSITIVELY ASSERTS safety it cannot know. Measured: with a live A and a conflicting B present, 2 wave sets / ACHIEVED CONCURRENCY 1 / separated by OverlappingReachableState; with A's slot removed, 'ALL SLOTS CO-RUN' and 'NO CONFLICT EDGES: the slots are disjoint on every computed relation' - a positive claim of disjointness about a hazard it can no longer see. Acting on it puts two agents on blk/1 at once, the exact collision D9 exists to prevent, CAUSED BY THE RECOVERY. Safe removal needs a liveness fact: ownership fails (a dead agent cannot clear its own slot) and a timer is forbidden (a hung holder and a busy one are indistinguishable). Documented as an honest gap in src/wave-control/RECOVERY.md instead.
